prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton California?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for everyone — the right attorney depends on the type of injury, the facts of your case, whether you want a trial lawyer or a negotiator, and your budget/availability. I can help you find the best match for your situation. A good next step is to tell me a few details:

- What kind of injury/accident (car crash, workplace injury, slip & fall, medical malpractice, etc.)?
- Are you looking for a local Pleasanton attorney or are nearby cities (Dublin, Livermore, San Ramon, Walnut Creek) OK?
- Do you prefer an attorney with strong trial experience, or one who focuses on obtaining fast settlements?
- Any other priorities (language, budget concerns, evening/weekend availability)?

How I’ll help once you answer: I can compile a shortlist (3–5 top-rated Pleasanton-area personal injury lawyers/law firms), including their specialties, notable results, client-review summaries, fee structure (usually contingency), and contact info so you can call for a free consult. 

If you want to start now without details, I can instead tell you what to look for when choosing (credentials, track record, client reviews, initial consult questions) and point you to reliable directories (California State Bar, Super Lawyers, Avvo, local bar referral). Which would you prefer?
